skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical foundations of restaurants and food service operations.
Grasp basic concepts such as restaurant customers and products.
Understand the historical development and future trends of restaurant operations.
Differentiate between various types of food service establishments and restaurants.
Manage investment and development activities for restaurants.
Organize production operations including menu planning, purchasing, inventory management, storage, and food preparation.
Implement marketing management activities for restaurants.
Analyze organizational models for restaurant management.
Consult and participate in investment and development projects for restaurants.
Apply theoretical knowledge to real-world scenarios in Vietnam's restaurant industry.
